notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and the sim backend (gymnasium.make of gym_aloha/AlohaInsertion-v0) was never run because gym_aloha needs MuJoCo and a GL context, which are not installed where the gate ran. The fake backend (fake.py) is a pure Python stand-in for gym_aloha.env:AlohaEnv: it models the action space (14-element Box -1 to 1), the observation space, the seeded object poses, the normalized gripper observation and the 300-step TimeLimit, but no physics: the commanded joint targets become the state, no contact is computed, so the contact-based reward (tasks/sim.py:174-219) is always 0 and a success is never observed. REAL IMAGE SIZE: the upstream observation image is 480 x 640 x 3 (tasks/sim.py:92, observation_height 480 and observation_width 640 at env.py:30-31); the fake returns a 4 x 6 x 3 stand-in of the same type and rank to keep receipts small, as the authoring guide and PLAYBOOK.md section 8 allow for this package, and the same statement is in the fidelity gaps. Five warnings are expected of every Gymnasium family driver (PLAYBOOK.md section 8): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only records the pending seed and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values[*], and seed of cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1); adding units was not attempted because the family derives those schemas. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests. Not covered: the transfer_cube task of the second registered environment (gym_aloha/AlohaTransferCube-v0), the pixel-only obs_type, the rendering path (AlohaEnv.render), and any comparison of the fake with the upstream environment. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the check report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted for control (actions, state, reward); the camera image is a 4 x 6 x 3 fake array in place of 480 x 640 x 3 (fidelity gaps), so a policy that needs the images waits for the artifact transport. The reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above. GYM-SPACE-REF (claude-opus-5-5, a model, 2026-10-31): driver.py now sets action_space_ref = gym_aloha/env.py:86, the upstream code whose bounds the fake's action space copies, so the step bounds derived from the fake's space are upstream_code with that ref; reference.json and REFERENCE.md were regenerated, and the digest above is the re-run gate's.
